title: Turkish Kazandibi with Nutty Crunch
description: A traditional Turkish dessert, kazandibi is a creamy semolina pudding topped with a nutty crunch. Inspired by the flavors of Turkey, this recipe adds a delightful twist to the classic dessert.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine milk, semolina flour, and sugar. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
2. Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla extract.
3. Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
5. To make the nutty crunch, melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium heat.
6. Add the chopped nuts and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.
7. Sprinkle the nutty crunch over the chilled kazandibi.
